shared_elements: arms or side appendages indicated along the body
horizontal bands or rows of repeated linear marks
justification: The main correspondence is that both surfaces include a highly schematic upright anthropomorphic form with body-related markings and some circular and band-like motifs arranged on a vertical surface. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by a front-facing human-like torso with facial and breast/body features, while B is dominated by multiple animal/profile figures and registers of signs on a T-shaped form rather than a single frontal body image.
